findings.evidence: focus.json stops 13-39 are all testimonial cards (the capture's 40-stop budget runs out inside the wall); dom-1440.json lists every card link twice (the loop copy is a live, focusable duplicate, e.g. 'Impeccable > Claude design Mertcan Yüzer' ×2). A keyboard user must tab through 60+ links of praise before reaching 'Detects and removes AI slop.', and a screen reader reads each quote twice.
findings.before: Second (loop) copy of .t-card links focusable and exposed
findings.after: Add aria-hidden="true" and inert to the duplicated track; make only the first copy focusable, or make cards non-links with a single 'Read all on X' link.
findings.why: WCAG 2.2 2.4.3 Focus Order and 1.3.2 Meaningful Sequence: duplicated content in the focus and reading order.

findings.where: command fader board ('Choose a command below. Drag a slider to compare'), 1440 tile 03
findings.evidence: The 11 faders (typeset, layout, colorize ... adapt) are div role="slider" with names, not native inputs; whether they respond to arrow keys and expose aria-valuenow cannot be confirmed from the capture. The hero before/after uses a native input type=range named 'Reveal the improved /polish example', which is the safer pattern.
findings.after: Use <input type="range"> as the hero does, or ensure tabindex=0, aria-valuemin/max/now and ArrowUp/ArrowDown handlers.
findings.why: WCAG 2.2 2.1.1 Keyboard and 4.1.2 Name, Role, Value; 2.5.7 Dragging Movements needs a non-drag alternative.

strengths: Skip link is the first focusable element; nav links, the GitHub link ('Impeccable on GitHub, 106k stars') and the hero range input all have descriptive names.

Agent logos carry their product names as alt ('Codex CLI', 'Claude Code', 'GitHub Copilot'); testimonial avatars are correctly alt="" beside the visible name; gallery images have alts ('Memory Quilt Atlas: example page design').
'Detector on' toggle shows state with text as well as colour.
not_investigated: Several sweep contrast/text-size hits ('Submit' 4.21:1 on #b14ece, 'MO'/'JL'/'PN' avatars) sit on the deliberate sample interface inside the command console; they are real rendered text so not disputed, but they are demo content.
Whether the testimonial wall auto-scrolls (2.2.2): tiles show cards cut at both edges but no motion evidence.
Live keyboard test of the role=slider faders and the /polish /distill /clarify toggles.
Gallery thumbnails appear blank in tiles; images report complete in dom, so treated as a capture timing artefact.
